rule.name: rule
rule.description: Defines a Drools rule containing a rule header (name and optional attributes), a 'when' condition clause (LHS), and a 'then' action clause (RHS).
rule.syntax:
rule "Rule Name"
  [attributes...]
  when
    [LHS pattern conditions]
  then
    [RHS actions]
end
rule.example:
rule "VIP Discount"
  salience 10
  when
    $c : Customer( tier == "GOLD" )
  then
    $c.setDiscount(0.20);
end

when.name: when
when.description: Left Hand Side (LHS) of a rule. Contains pattern constraints and logical elements (and, or, not, exists, accumulate, eval) evaluated against working memory facts.
when.syntax:
when
  $p : Person( age > 18 )
  not Blacklist( personId == $p.id )

then.name: then
then.description: Right Hand Side (RHS) of a rule. Contains Java/MVEL action code executed when LHS conditions evaluate to true. Supports engine actions like modify, insert, retract, and delete.

salience.name: salience
salience.description: Defines rule execution priority. Rules with higher salience values are executed before rules with lower salience values. Default is 0. Can accept negative numbers or dynamic expressions.

agenda-group.name: agenda-group
agenda-group.description: Assigns a rule to a named agenda group. Rules in an agenda group only fire when that group receives focus.

auto-focus.name: auto-focus
auto-focus.description: When true, automatically sets focus to the rule's agenda-group when the rule's LHS conditions are matched.

no-loop.name: no-loop
no-loop.description: Prevents a rule from re-triggering itself when it modifies facts in its 'then' section that would match its own 'when' conditions.

lock-on-active.name: lock-on-active
lock-on-active.description: Enhanced version of no-loop. Prevents rules within the same ruleflow-group or agenda-group from re-activating when facts are modified by other rules in the group.

activation-group.name: activation-group
activation-group.description: Rules belonging to the same activation-group are mutually exclusive. Only the first rule to fire in the group will execute; others are cancelled.

duration.name: duration
duration.description: Fires the rule after a specified time delay (in milliseconds) if the rule conditions remain true throughout the duration.

timer.name: timer
timer.description: Schedules rule execution according to an interval or cron expression.

calendars.name: calendars
calendars.description: Controls rule activation based on defined Quartz calendar rules.

date-effective.name: date-effective
date-effective.description: Date from which the rule becomes active and eligible to fire.

date-expires.name: date-expires
date-expires.description: Date after which the rule is disabled and will no longer fire.

declare.name: declare
declare.description: Declares new in-memory fact types, metadata, or extends existing Java classes without requiring separate .java source files.
declare.example:
declare Customer
  id : String
  totalSpent : double
end

query.name: query
query.description: Defines a searchable query to retrieve facts matching specific conditions from working memory.
query.example:
query "HighValueAccounts" (double minBalance)
  $acc : Account( balance >= minBalance )
end

global.name: global
global.description: Declares global variables available across all rules in the KieSession (e.g., services, loggers, results lists).
global.example:
global org.slf4j.Logger logger;
global com.example.service.AlertService alertService;

function.name: function
function.description: Defines utility functions written in Java code that can be called from rule LHS conditions or RHS actions.

accumulate.name: accumulate
accumulate.description: Iterates over a dataset of facts, performing aggregate function calculations (sum, avg, min, max, count, collectList) or custom multi-stage calculation blocks (init, action, reverse, result).
accumulate.syntax:
accumulate( <pattern>; <target> : <function>(<expr>) )
accumulate( <pattern>; init(..), action(..), reverse(..), result(..) )

over.name: over
over.description: Specifies a sliding CEP window (time-based or length-based) over an event stream.

from.name: from
from.description: Specifies a data source for a pattern (e.g. from an entry-point, global list, or object field expression) rather than querying working memory directly.

after.name: after
after.description: Evaluates whether event B occurred after event A within optional minimum and maximum time offsets.

before.name: before
before.description: Evaluates whether event B occurred before event A within optional time offsets.

coincides.name: coincides
coincides.description: Evaluates whether two events occur simultaneously within a given tolerance threshold.

modify.name: modify
modify.description: Notifies the Drools engine that fact properties have changed, triggering re-evaluation of rules that depend on those properties.

insert.name: insert
insert.description: Inserts a new fact into working memory.

retract.name: retract
retract.description: Retracts/deletes a fact from working memory.

delete.name: delete
delete.description: Alias for retract; removes a fact from working memory.

@role.name: @role
@role.description: Defines whether a declared fact type is treated as a standard 'fact' or a time-sensitive 'event' in Complex Event Processing (CEP).

@timestamp.name: @timestamp
@timestamp.description: Specifies which field of an event fact holds the timestamp value.

@expires.name: @expires
@expires.description: Defines the expiration duration after which an event fact is automatically retracted from working memory.
